_README: Where a piece of a survey joins the rest, decided once and kept.
The closing step has to be told where to enter and leave any piece
held on by fewer than two ends of its own. Left to itself it works
that out afresh every run, so a repair anywhere changes what it
invents somewhere else. An attachment takes the decision away: a line
from a point on the piece to a point on the rest, chosen on a map with
the person reviewing it, never recomputed.
An attachment is not walked and is not boundary. It is drawn and
counted as a chord like any other, and its metres are reported as line
